name: Norms: the temptation to defect (Galán & Izquierdo Fig. 11)
description: Galán & Izquierdo's Fig. 11: the metanorms game against the temptation T; the metric is the share of runs with the norm established. They report that a larger temptation keeps the norm. Measured (release, seeds 1–10, recorded 2026-09-26): after 10 000 generations 0.8, 0.9, 0.9, 1.0, 1.0 and 1.0 at T = 1, 3, 5, 7, 10 and 12 — at this horizon the norm mostly holds anyway; the difference shows by 10⁵ generations, where T = 10 keeps every run established and T = 3 only 52 of 100 (100 seeds, measured in planning; the survey's 50 seeds at T = 10: established 50 of 50).
